title: Snapchat Ad Campaign
description: Schema for validating Snapchat Ads API campaign, ad squad, ad, and creative entities used in the advertising lifecycle.

Organization.description: An Organization represents a brand, partner, or ad agency on the Snapchat advertising platform.

id.description: The unique identifier of the organization.

address_line_1.description: First line of the organization address.

locality.description: City or locality of the organization.

administrative_district_level_1.description: State or province of the organization.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the organization was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the organization was last updated.

AdAccount.description: An Ad Account contains advertising campaigns and is owned by an Organization.

id.description: The unique identifier of the ad account.

name.description: The name of the ad account.

organization_id.description: The ID of the parent organization.

status.description: The status of the ad account.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the ad account.

funding_source_ids.description: Array of funding source IDs associated with this account.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the ad account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the ad account was last updated.

Campaign.description: A Campaign defines a business objective and organizes Ad Squads for aggregate reporting.

id.description: The unique identifier of the campaign.

ad_account_id.description: The ID of the parent ad account.

daily_budget_micro.description: Daily budget in micro-currency units (1,000,000 micro = 1 unit of currency).

lifetime_spend_cap_micro.description: Lifetime spend cap in micro-currency units.

start_time.description: The start time of the campaign.

end_time.description: The end time of the campaign.

objective_v2_properties.description: The v2 objective properties for the campaign, replacing the deprecated objective field.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the campaign was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the campaign was last updated.

AdSquad.description: An Ad Squad organizes ads within a campaign, defining targeting, budget, schedule, and bid strategy.

id.description: The unique identifier of the ad squad.

name.description: The name of the ad squad.

campaign_id.description: The ID of the parent campaign.

status.description: The status of the ad squad.

bid_micro.description: The bid amount in micro-currency units.

start_time.description: The start time of the ad squad.

end_time.description: The end time of the ad squad.

targeting.description: Targeting criteria for the ad squad.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the ad squad was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the ad squad was last updated.

Ad.description: An Ad is an individual ad unit delivered to users, belonging to an Ad Squad and referencing a Creative.

id.description: The unique identifier of the ad.

ad_squad_id.description: The ID of the parent ad squad.

creative_id.description: The ID of the creative used by this ad.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the ad was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the ad was last updated.

Creative.description: A Creative defines the visual and interactive content of an ad.

id.description: The unique identifier of the creative.

ad_account_id.description: The ID of the parent ad account.

headline.description: The headline text displayed on the creative.

brand_name.description: The brand name displayed on the creative.

shareable.description: Whether the creative can be shared by users.

top_snap_media_id.description: The media ID for the top snap creative asset.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the creative was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the creative was last updated.
